about_the_game:
THE JALECO SOCCER INVASION HAS SPREAD TO STEAM!




Experience the ultimate soccer showdown with Goal!, the original NES and SNES classics that first brought real-world tactics and Cup intensity to your living rooms.


The clock ticks down.


The roar of the crowd rises in a deafening chant!


Suddenly, your winger breaks free, and spots the open man in the middle. Pass...shot...Goal! It’s the world’s favorite sport, and soon to become your favorite new home video game, thanks to Jaleco! Because Goal! brings soccer to life like you’ve never seen it.




Goal! / Moero!! Pro Soccer (NES, 1988-1989)


  • Choose from 24 different teams.

  • Includes Exhibition matches, Tournaments, and Penalty Kick shootouts modes.

  • Adjust your team's formation and playstyle before each match.

  • Take direct control of your goalkeeper during critical saves.

  • Compete head-to-head or team up against the CPU.

  • Unleash powerful kicks that bend and blast toward the goal.

  • Complete manuals in English, French, Dutch, German, Spanish and Japanese.

  • Check out the details on the preserved original box art.


Goal! / Super Goal! / Super Cup Soccer (SNES, 1992-1993)


  • Choose from an international field of 24 teams.

  • Includes Match Play and Super Cup tournament modes.

  • Multiple play perspectives, including full field "radar".

  • A closeup instant replay of scoring shots.

  • Special moves...  kick, block, head, bicycle kick, pass or steal.

  • Choose from 4 defensive formations.

  • Complete manuals in English, French, Dutch, German, Spanish and Japanese.

  • Check out the details on the preserved original box art.



Authentic Action – Feel the excitement of every kick, pass, and block with intuitive controls and strategic gameplay.



Seamlessly switch between the NES and SNES versions anytime including all regional releases of both games.


Rewind the action like a VHS tape – missed that goal or pass? Go back in time and try again!


Need help? The original localized manuals are built-in and always ready to guide you!


Retro Presentation – Play with a classic TV CRT filter or with the many other display options for the ultimate nostalgia.


Compete against the world and your friends on the monthly leaderboards.


With Remote Play support you can play on the go and invite your friends from around the globe to play a friendly vs match, team up for a tournament, or battle for the cup together.



Whether you're a longtime fan of Goal! or a newcomer ready to experience one of the most beloved soccer franchises, it's time to don your kit and step onto the pitch!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core series or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any compliant Direct3D11 GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Experience the ultimate soccer showdown! Featuring 24 different teams and intense arcade-style gameplay, these original NES & SNES favorites are back to deliver fast-paced football fun. Play a quick match or complete for the Cup—don your kit and step onto the pitch today!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
